transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. Let's go through each area: technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — please report your final operating requirements. I need to hear from all four before I can sign off on the package.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical requirement. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure it's on everyone's radar now since it's not on Mara's draft lock sheet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights restriction. The signed performance license I received this morning — which has been countersigned — permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release and prohibits any later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. I have not yet entered this restriction into the rights tracker, but it is binding. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive, since that would constitute a video-on-demand-style reuse beyond the broadcast. We need to remove the festival archive reuse provision from the package before lock, or secure a separate license amendment.

transcript.text: I need to flag two critical talent requirements from the headliner's agent that I confirmed by email but haven't yet entered into the production schedule. First, the headliner can only soundcheck at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday — no other time slots are available. Second, the headliner's rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision that includes a sponsor product display on stage. We need to remove or relocate the sponsor product display from the stage before lock.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical accessibility requirement. My caption vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B — its dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general control-room location listed in the current plan will not work. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the Booth B assignment to the lock sheet, so it needs to be added before lock.
